chunks: And in the narration of ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Abū Baṣīr, he said: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:
"The muhrim may pronounce divorce, but he may not marry."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a person in the state of ihram pronounce divorce or contract a marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the person in ihram. It states that while a muhrim may issue a divorce, entering into marriage is not permitted during the state of ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2713 - In the narration of Asim ibn Humayd from Abu Basir, he said: I heard Imam Abu Abdullah (as) say: "
A person in the state of ihram may pronounce divorce but may not marry."
